title: Prompting just split into 4 different skills

passages.text: Most people think they’re good at prompting. They’re not — they’re good at *chatting*

- **7 prompts and a pre-flight check.** A pen-and-paper thinking exercise before you touch AI, a 10-minute quick start that scores where you stand and builds your first context document, and the full build-out — specification engineer, intent framework builder
